review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the calibration belief and the 20 other belief files at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (claim: 2 of 6 high-confidence beliefs later revised, recounted from the files) and on a deterministic analysis whose 32 self-checks pass. The belief is written by the applying script from a recommendation computed in the ix repository; the counting rule and the confidence formula are cited from that producer's script, outside the pin, and the revision rates, the error rates of the decision rule and the forecasters fed to the nudge rule are assumptions or synthetic, not measurements of the project. The draft concludes that this sample cannot distinguish a calibrated forecaster from an overconfident one. Human subject review, learner trial and publication remain pending; the French and Spanish translations have had no native-speaker review.
